title: Object Storage: billing cycle
content:
Object Storage billing cycle is defined as follows: Recurring invoice window basis; string.

| Contract tier | Billing cycle |
| --- | --- |
| Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB | billing cycle: calendar month |
| Northbridge Object Storage 10 TB | billing cycle: calendar month |
| Northbridge Object Storage 25 TB | billing cycle: calendar month |
| Northbridge Object Storage 50 TB | billing cycle: calendar month |
| Northbridge Object Storage 100 TB | billing cycle: calendar month |
| Northbridge Object Storage 250 TB | billing cycle: calendar month |

## Tier reference

For Northbridge Object Storage 5 TB, the billing cycle entry is calendar month.
